data.body:
CI note: patchset 1's first `Verified -1` was `require resolvable rebar ticket: FAILED` — a PUSH-TIMING RACE, not a bad trailer. This ticket was created minutes before the push and the first `claim` returned `push_status: {state: pending, reason: lock-timeout, unpushed: 14}`, so its CREATE event had not reached `origin/tickets` when CI tried to resolve `a68c-9633-248c-4b06`. It resolves now (`git log origin/tickets --grep=a68c` finds its events), and `rebar fsck` showed only 1 commit still pending, flushed by this write.

Patchset 1's SECOND `Verified -1` was different again and also not a code failure: every job reports `CANCELLED (not a test verdict)` because patchset 2 superseded the run. That is exactly the conflation `deistic-conventual-blackmamba` names — a cancelled run voting `Verified -1 FAILURE` — showing up on this very change while I was fixing its sibling in the drift workflow.

Neither is a defect in the change. Patchset 2's CI is running.
